purpose: Teach: 移す/解き/外す/謙虚/造り/削っ/抱き/なさら

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業期、本気で、絶対、工場、絶対、移す、絶対、決断、絶対、なさったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Dad made the founding decision to move the factory—he did it with absolute conviction. I'm asking you to remember that.
lines.style: Quiet weight on the memory. Measured pace, like placing stones. The opening soft but firm. A man passing something on, not lecturing. Slight pause before 'absolute conviction'—he's choosing the words with care.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが、本気で、絶対、難題、絶対、解き、絶対、明かされた、絶対、お姿、絶対、引き継いでおります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. My father solved the most difficult problems, and the way he carried himself—I've inherited that from him. I'm grateful for it.
lines.style: Direct, steady eye contact. Respect in every syllable but no performance. Slight deepening on 'inherited'—he's claiming it, not just receiving it. Warm and formal at once.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、古い慣習、絶対、外す、絶対、勇気、絶対、お持ちだったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Dad had the courage to strip away the old ways—the stubborn habits that held us back. He truly did.
lines.style: Slower now, almost mournful. The voice drops slightly. Not sad, but tender for what was. Each phrase deliberate, as if handling something fragile. A pause between the old ways and the courage it took.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは、本気で、絶対、謙虚、絶対、な、絶対、お方でした、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. My father was a humble man, and I carry that humility with me every day. For that, I'm deeply grateful.
lines.style: Reflective, inward-facing. Softer than before. The words almost to himself, but spoken aloud for his son to hear. A quiet conviction that needs no proving.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、店舗の、絶対、造り、絶対、こだわったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Dad cared about every detail of the store—he wouldn't accept anything less than perfect.
lines.style: Tender memory in the voice. Slower pace, almost reverent. A slight waver on 'perfect'—pride and longing mixed. He's seeing the store as it was, through his father's eyes.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが、本気で、絶対、無駄、絶対、削っ、絶対、た、絶対、姿勢、絶対、引き継いでおります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. My father removed the waste from everything—cut out what didn't matter. That discipline, that stance—I carry it forward. I'm grateful for it.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Steady rhythm, like a rhythm that's been practiced. The word 'discipline' gets a light emphasis. Not boastful—just steady inheritance being named.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、社員、絶対、抱き、絶対、しめる、絶対、お方だったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Dad was the kind of man who truly held his people close—cared for them like family.
lines.style: Voice warms considerably. The pace opens up slightly. Genuine affection underneath. A small smile in the tone. He's seeing his father's face when he says this—the generosity was real.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが、本気で、絶対、なさら、絶対、ない、絶対、ご決断、絶対、いつも、絶対、信頼しておりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. My father made decisions that showed his faith in us—his people—and I've trusted that same faith all my life. For everything he was, I'm grateful.
lines.style: Comes full circle, almost like a benediction. Slower, deeper. The final gratitude carries the weight of a lifetime. Not rushed. A man closing a chapter with honour. Slight catch on 'everything he was'—the father is fully gone now.
